wps_page.title: Whole Plasmid Sequencing (WPS) · Oxford Nanopore | Macrogen
wps_page.lead: Analyze the entire plasmid with Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) long reads, with no sequencing primers. Verify the backbone and insert in a single service and identify sequence changes or structural differences anywhere in the plasmid.
wps_page.promo_line: Launch price from USD 9 · EUR 10 per sample, until 31 January 2027
wps_page.portal_hint: In the portal: Order › Nanopore SEQ › Whole Plasmid SEQ, under CES. You need to log in with your account.
wps_page.price_sub: Applied automatically in the order portal. When you order, choose the range that matches your plasmid size.
wps_page.price_note: Promotional prices per sample for orders placed in the portal between 4 November 2026 and 31 January 2027. Invoicing in USD (Chile and Peru) or EUR (Spain and Portugal); taxes depend on the billing country. Cannot be combined with other promotions. The crossed-out price is the regular price of the product in the order portal.
wps_page.after_title: Check the price of each WPS product
wps_page.after_text: The current price of each WPS product appears when you create your order in the portal. If you have questions, write to us and we will help you choose.
wps_page.vs_sub: Sanger sequencing reads a limited region per reaction. WPS reads the entire plasmid at once. The two methods are complementary.
wps_page.wps_li1: Analyzes the entire plasmid with long reads.
wps_page.wps_li3: Verifies the backbone and insert in a single workflow.
wps_page.wps_li4: Identifies unexpected sequence changes, insertions, deletions or rearrangements across the plasmid.
wps_page.sanger_li1: Reads a region of approximately 600–900 bp per reaction, depending on sequencing conditions and read quality.
wps_page.sanger_li2: Needs a primer for each region.
wps_page.sanger_li3: A suitable choice for targeted verification of a specific nucleotide change in a defined region.
wps_page.sanger_li4: Can be used to confirm specific variants detected with WPS.
wps_page.req_type_td: Purified plasmid DNA from a single construct of clonal origin
wps_page.req_conc_td: 50–100 ng/µL, best measured by fluorescence (Qubit or plate reader); NanoDrop is less accurate for concentration
wps_page.req_buf_td: Nuclease-free water or low-EDTA TE · 1.5 mL tube or 96-well plate
wps_page.req_tat_td: Typically 1–3 business days after the samples reach the laboratory
wps_page.warn_qc: No pre-QC: samples are sequenced directly, with no prior quality check. Check the requirements when you order; a gel check of the DNA is recommended.
wps_page.warn_intl: International shipments: only purified plasmid DNA is accepted. Under living modified organism (LMO) regulations, bacterial cultures and colonies are not accepted, and we do not offer plasmid purification. Dry ice shipping carries an additional fee. Additional charges may apply if sequencing fails because the sample does not meet the submission requirements.
wps_page.get_intro: When the order is complete, you download the results from your portal account, as 5 files:
wps_page.get1_td: Status of each sample (assembly success), circular map with annotations, dot plot and read statistics
wps_page.get2_td: Assembled consensus sequence of the plasmid
wps_page.get3_td: Consensus sequence with its base quality scores
wps_page.get4_td: Assembled sequence with the available annotations
wps_page.get_note: The report format is still being finalized and may change.
wps_page.ref_title: No reference needed: de novo assembly
wps_page.ref_text: A reference sequence is not always required: the plasmid is reconstructed by de novo assembly. If you specify a registered reference in your order, the dot plot compares the structure of the assembly with it (expected-assembly criteria: coverage ≥ 95% and identity ≥ 99%).
wps_page.how_title: Three steps in the portal, under CES
wps_page.how1: Log in at dna.macrogen.com and go to Order › Nanopore SEQ › Whole Plasmid SEQ. Choose your plasmid's range: 1–5, 5–25, 25–125 or 125–300 kb.
wps_page.how2: Tube or 96-well plate and, for each sample, name, concentration, volume and approximate size in kb. You can also download the portal's Excel template, fill it in and upload it. Names: letters, digits, "-" and "_" only, up to 15 characters, no duplicates.
wps_page.how3: Complete the billing details and ship the purified DNA. The report and files will be available in your account.
wps_page.q1: Why is the assembled sequence twice the expected size, or why does it contain repeats?
wps_page.a1: An assembly larger than expected may indicate plasmid multimers, such as dimers or higher-order forms, or may result from other sample- or assembly-related factors. If the size does not match or you see unexpected repeats, write to us with the expected size and, if available, the reference sequence, and we will review the result.
wps_page.q2: Can errors occur in homopolymer or ITR regions?
wps_page.a2: Some sequence contexts are harder for long reads. Homopolymer regions (runs of the same base, such as AAAAAA) and short tandem repeats can be associated with insertion or deletion errors, and some inverted terminal repeats (ITRs) may need careful review. If a critical region gives an unexpected result, further review or validation with another method, such as Sanger, may be recommended.
wps_page.q3: What if my sample contains several plasmids or genomic DNA?
wps_page.a3: WPS is designed for samples containing a single plasmid construct of clonal origin. A mixture of plasmids, fragmented plasmid DNA or genomic DNA contamination can reduce data quality or give an incomplete or unexpected assembly.
wps_page.a4: The most common causes are a concentration that is too low or too high, degraded or contaminated DNA, a mixture of several plasmids, or too little DNA to reach the target data amount. As there is no pre-QC, it is best to check the sample before shipping it.
wps_page.q5: Can I send bacterial cultures or colonies?
wps_page.a5: Not for international shipments. Under living modified organism (LMO) regulations, we currently accept only purified plasmid DNA from overseas, and we do not offer plasmid purification.
wps_page.cta_title: Do you have plasmids to verify?
wps_page.cta_text: Order in the portal or write to us: our specialists in Madrid and Santiago will help you choose the range and prepare your samples.
wps_page.meta_desc: Sequence the whole plasmid, backbone and insert, with Oxford Nanopore long reads and no primers. Plasmids from 1 to 300 kb, ordered through the Macrogen portal.
wps_page.pop_text: WPS: backbone and insert in one service, no primers. From USD 9 · €10 per sample until 31 January 2027.
